unit: c: footprint outline as x,y pairs in half-metres east and north of the pin

source.name: Overture Maps Foundation, buildings theme, release 2026-10-21.0

fields.mh: height of the lowest part above ground
fields.i: 1 if the footprint touches the 150 m circle

method: Overture buildings whose footprint touches the 250 m radius around the pin, nearest first, at most 700 per project, outlines simplified to 0.4 m and rounded to 0.5 m. Heights are drawn only where mapped; buildings without a mapped height are drawn at a nominal 3 m and shown in a lighter colour.
